From: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: VPC endpoints & IP allowlist - technical details

Hi Samir - quick technical clarifications from the SE side. I've kept these focused to help your infra/security review:

1) Connectivity options
   - Hosted (recommended for fastest time-to-value): Use IP allowlist + optional egress-to-cloud regions. We provide a published set of egress IP ranges per region (will provide CIDRs).
   - Dedicated / Private: We offer AWS PrivateLink / VPC Endpoint support for Dedicated customers. For Private (on-prem) deployments we can install behind your network and integrate with your KMS/HSM.

2) IP allowlist & egress
   - We publish a stable CIDR block list per region and update with 30 days' notice. For initial integration we provide the current list for us-west-2.
   - Outbound egress for callbacks/embeddings/rerankers: calls from our runtime to your endpoints (if you host a callback) will come from the same egress ranges.

3) DNS
   - For split-horizon: configure an internal forwarder that routes *.redwood.internal to our private endpoint; we'll provide the private zone names.
   - If you need example Route53 settings, we can share a sample Terraform snippet.

4) mTLS / Auth
   - We support mTLS for Dedicated/Private control-plane connections. You can either provide client certs or use a cert provisioning flow.
   - SDK auth: tokens (API keys) are used for authenticated API calls. For stronger security we recommend signed JWTs or integration via your IdP + short-lived tokens.

5) SDK / routing / embeddings / reranker notes
   - Our SDKs (Python/Node/Go) support setting a base_url to your private endpoint for routing traffic into the private deployment.
   - Structured output & tool calling: payloads are identical; the runtime handles tool hooks locally when deployed in the same VPC.
   - Embeddings / rerankers: vector service calls can be routed internally; we recommend colocating embedding store inside the same private network to avoid cross-region egress costs.

6) Next steps
   - Marissa / Samir: schedule a 60-minute integration call (networking + auth + routing) with your infra/security + our SEs.
   - I'll send the us-west-2 CIDR list and a sample Route53/Terraform snippet in a follow-up.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
